title: Expected failures
description: The conformance cases one connector is known to fail, in a file named expected-failures.yaml beside the connector's adapter, each by the case's ID. The list is strict: a listed case that passes fails the run, and an entry that names no connector case, or none of the case's permutations, fails the conformance project's checks.

expected_failure.description: The permutations of one case the connector is known to fail. Unset, transports, platforms and vias mean every one the case applies to.

reason.description: Why it fails, naming the issue that tracks the fix, in one or two sentences of plain text.

transports.description: The transports on which it fails.

platforms.description: The platforms on which it fails.

vias.description: What the requests go through on which it fails, for a case that runs once for each.
